story.head: A grinder’s delight
paras: Both teams have won two in a row. Going in, the Panthers are fifth in the Atlantic (13th in the NHL) and the Blues seventh in the Central (tied for 18th).

The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st), hit a lot (1st) and don't block many shots (32nd). The Blues keep things calm after the whistle (lowest) and rarely get pinned in their own end (3rd). They also have struggled on the power play (31st), so the Cats’ power play bites, but theirs doesn’t. Both teams play slow, low-event hockey, so expect a tight one.

Matthew Tkachuk (4 G / 24 A / 28 P in 20 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games. Sam Reinhart (11 G / 8 A / 19 P in 20 GP) has a team-high eleven goals, with a point in five straight games against St. Louis. Jimmy Snuggerud (10 G / 4 A / 14 P in 19 GP) is tied for the Blues’ scoring lead. Robert Thomas (3 G / 11 A / 14 P in 19 GP) shares it.
Jacob Markström (5-3-1 / .900 SV% in 10 GS) is in line to start for Florida. Joel Hofer (8-5-1 / .926 SV% in 14 GS) has been a rock in net for St. Louis and will likely start.
